summary: Cadiz Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its affiliate Fenner Gap Mutual Water Company entered into two Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) agreements for the Mojave Groundwater Bank Northern Pipeline project. The Lyles Agreement sets a guaranteed maximum price (GMP) of ~$218.9 million for pump-station facilities, with Lyles bearing cost overruns. This is a routine infrastructure contract filing, not a special situation—no acquisition, divestiture, or other corporate event. The filing provides no deal terms regarding securities or corporate control. What to watch: project financing and construction milestones, but no arbitrage angle.
